content.short: Benqi is an advanced decentralized protocol designed for seamless decentralized lending dapps within the Web3 ecosystem on Avalanche.
content.description: Lending, borrowing, and liquid staking on Avalanche. By leveraging the underlying security and performance of the Avalanche network(s), Benqi aims to deliver a robust and scalable solution for its users. The project offers a suite of decentralized tools tailored for decentralized lending dapps, ensuring transparent and trustless operations. As the Web3 landscape continues to evolve, Benqi is positioning itself as a core infrastructure component to empower builders and end-users alike, bridging the gap between traditional architectures and decentralized networks.
